nom: DERMA E Vitamin C Whipped Radiance Polish

avis.texte: Was looking for some kind of exfoliation/microdermabrasion product and came across this! I love the whipped feel its light on the skin and the star hole it comes out of is cute. Big fan of the scent, kind of orange scented which is fitting. I hope this product exists forever and never discontinues.

The first couple of times I used this product, I used very little and it left my face looking dull. Not something I expected from a Vitamin C product, but I kept giving it a go because I really like all my other DermaE products. The third time I applied this product to my face I used a little bit more and it DESTROYED my skin. Red, dry, irritated welts appeared all over my face. It's been 2 weeks since then and I'm still trying to get my healthy skin back. I will never put this product on my skin again. And truthfully, I've lost a bit of trust in DermaE. I should have known better by now abrasive it felt, but there are so many positive reviews on this product.
Love how easy it comes out star tip nozzle and very gentle on skin. Love the smell as well!
I'm a huge fan of all things Derma-E, except this. It leaves my skin looking veryyyy dull and pale… completely opposite of what you'd expect from a "radiance polish" unfortunately.

This polish is amazing. I use it twice a week. I absolutely love the feel of it and I feel like it works well. My skin feels smooth afterward and I look forward to using it. The smell is absolutely amazing. Citrusy, but not too strong. I hope they never get rid of this product. I will definitely be restocking this

I tried this twice. The first time i had two painful cystic acne bumps on my chin. I thought maybe it wasnt this product & the acne was hormonal. So i decided to give this another try when those cystic acne bumps were better. But guess what… more deep painful cystic acne bumps. This time above my eyebrow. This product aays safe for sensitive skin so im not sure why im having a reaction like this. I really wanted it to work :(

Fantastic exfoliator! Refreshing citrus scent and texture. A little goes a long way. I like to apply this a couple of times per week to damp skin, massage gently, and then add a gel cleanser over top. The star tip is a fun way to dispense the product. I prefer this over the vitamin C paste.

i love the vitamin c cleansing paste that can also be used as a mask. this does not compare despite ingredients to the contrary. its a big "skip it" from me. granuals are too big and may cause micro-tears, thr amount of vitamin c in this isnt comperable to the paste.
The granules are rather large and were rough on the face. I was only able to use it once so have no opinion on the efficacy. I returned the product.
My skin was so soft & literally glowing after the first use. Excellent exfoliation & smells incredible. It's an easy add to my skin care routine 3x a week for brighter, smoother skin.
My skin was so smooth and soft after the first use. The smoothness did not diminish through the day. So pleased with the noticeable difference in my skin.
This polish is a very fine scrub that left my skin feeling refreshed and smooth.

avis.titre: A little rough but worth the results
avis.texte: Face feels exfoliated and fresh. My the skin under my eyebrows can get dry and flakey and this has helped manage that problem. The initial texture is a bit rough but feels good after a few seconds. A little doesn't really go a long way before the exfoliant disintegrates but its not terrible. The scent is amazing!
This is amazing. It rubs off all the dullness and doesn't make your face super red like other exfoliants do.

I enjoyed the star shaped tip when applying the radiance polish and I love the finely milled consistency of the product. Most face scrubs have beads that don't actually do anything but I definitely felt this one make my skin noticeably softer after the first use!
Loveddd how my skin felt so soft after - cant wait to use again!
The texture feels like a microdermabrasion scrub. Smells great too!
My skin felt moisturized, hydrated, looked healthier. Overall felt wonderful on my skin.

avis.titre: Baby smooth skin after only a few uses
avis.texte: I loved this product. My skin if very sensitive to many products and this product did not hurt my skin. After only a few uses my face looked brighter and felt baby smooth.
Absolutely impressed by this scrub it felt so smoothing and I noticed my skin looked like I got a facial afterwards I was glowing and it felt so SMOOTH. I can't wait to keep using it!!!

It felt tingling in a good way. During application, it felt like the scrub was removing all the dead skin cells from my face. My skin felt smooth and my skin's appearance had improved just after 3 uses

This polish reminds me of my now-discontinued favorite - it is fine grained with a light fragrance and gently but effectively exfoliated my skin. A little goes a long way; the same amount I'd use of my old favorite was enough to do not only my face and neck, but also my décolletage and even my arms, all with no irritation. So glad to have found a new favorite.
Super gentle, but effective. Left my skin feeling soft and clean. Isn't drying or irritating. Smells great.

avis.titre: Instructions had me not wanting to use
avis.texte: I assume you are to rinse the product off, but it doesn't state that. I could feel grit, which is great for exfoliating, however I couldn't just leave that in my skin. Eww after washing off it felt very smooth and soft.

avis.titre: Holy Cow! This Vitamin C Polish Made My Skin Glow Instantly
avis.texte: Wow, I'm so impressed with the Vitamin C Whipped Radiance Polish! It left my skin glowing and feeling so smooth. I love how it exfoliates while also keeping my skin hydrated. This product is truly amazing!
I tried this in the shower it was so exfoliating but wasn't rough at all. I love the texture and it really felt like it got a lot of dead skin off and roughness off of my face!
Lightly-scented, gentle yet effective exfoliating scrub that left my skin feeling extra clean and moisturized and looking brighter. My sensitive skin responds well to this polish.
This product made my face feel very refreshed. The smell was very pleasant.

I noticed it reminded me of the Joanna Vargas Exfoliating Mask which is the only one I use as it is my favorite on the market! But being introduced to the Whipped Radiance Polish has quickly changed my mind! The way my skin felt after one use, the glow it gave me and not to mention the generous size is my dream exfoliator!
This scrub worked really well. As soon as I rinsed off, the feel of my skin was incredible. So smooth and vibrant.

It feels like a soft but fine scrub. It's not too coarse, fells like fine sand. It makes my skin super clean, the scent is very nice and the best part, you can see your skin glow without irritation or dryness. I have mature mixed skin and it's the best exfoliation product I have tried!

avis.titre: Great polish, beware of sensitive skin
avis.texte: I liked the polish and my skin felt great but it may feel rough on sensitive skin.

I've only used this product once, and I was pleasantly surprised by how smooth my skin felt immediately after use. I particularly love the refreshing citrus scent, which is perfect for the summer. The product was gentle enough to exfoliate my face without being too abrasive, leaving my skin feeling soft and smooth, without any oily residue. I would definitely recommend this product to anyone looking for a gentle exfoliator for their skin.
This product is a game changer. I am in my mid it's and my skin immediately felt more youthful!

I loved the radiance polish it really removed all the dead skin off my face and made my skin glow. I enjoy using it the days after I come home from with a good sweat from the gym. My skin has felt so great after use and I will continue to keep using this moving forward.
Absolutely loved this whipped radiance polish. The feel of the product was weightless. Felt very refreshing on my skin.

My skin has become more sensitive over the last few years so I usually stay away from exfoliants, but the whipped polish effectively exfoliated my skin and works nicely to provide that extra "deep cleaning" without feeling harsh/abrasive or drying. I had a little breakout around my chin & jaw the next morning, but will need to try the polish a few more times to see if it had to do with the actual product or it was just my skin's initial shock/reaction to an exfoliant.
I noticed my skin looked very bright after a few times using the Vit C polish
Love this! The vitamin C whipped radiance polish leaves my skin feeling fresh,clean and glowing. The scent is so refreshing. It's definitely a product I'll use again.
Did a great job exfoliating without stripping away all of the moisture. I have sensitive skin and it worked well.
Felt very chalky and would have preferred to use in the shower versus after just washing my face. I liked the smell
My skin felt bright and clean after using. It was a big grainy, but I think I may have used too much product, 100% my fault. This is definitely a product I will in the future.

Really liked the results from this, but it has so much exfoliant it took me a long time to rinse it all off. I still found exfoliant on my skin the next morning. But worked really well! Just best for "everything showers" when you can get your hair wet too as you remove all the exfoliant! I liked the color and the package, though. I will still use this but only in the shower and not at my sink.

For a polish it seemed super gritty and I did not expect it to have glitter in it. For being whipped I wish it had more volume and was fluffier. Does work well and skin felt very smooth after use. Product did not instruct to rinse off after and I wish it included that on the packaging.

I loved this product! The superfine texture of the whipped polish was great- not coarse like so many scrubs. The scent reminded me of high-end spa products, and the results were immediate, My skin looked and felt refreshed and brighter right away.

Love how the polish comes out looking like icing! So cute with the colors and sparkles and it left my skin feeling so bright and smooth. This was a great way to take the day off at night before bed and is also great to start the day with!
At first I was hesitant I thought it would be harsh but it definitely was not. After one use my skin felt much smoother and felt refreshed

avis.titre: The only face scrub I'll ever use!
avis.texte: Certain apricot walnut face scrubs popular in the 2000s made me swear off physical exfoliants, but this polish has certainly changed my mind! I like that in addition to a physical exfoliant (volcanic ash), there's a chemical one as well— it's an excellent and effective combo! The polish left my skin smooth, supple, and brighter after just one use. This is the only face scrub I'll even consider using from now on!

With sensitive skin many of the exfoliating scrubs often feel a bit harsh, but I really liked this scrub. I felt like it had enough texture to make a difference and felt smoother without feeling abrasive.
After using the Polish once, my skin looked brighter and felt way smoother. It definitely felt more refreshed, and the dullness was way less noticeable. Loved how it made my skin feel!

I love the Derma E microdermabrasion scrub, but sometimes it can be a little too abrasive. This new polish is the perfect consistency and is really effective without being harsh. Bonus points for the cute packaging!
